draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 45th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 3rd of 11 at TE. He went 55th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Tyler Eifert. Testing concerns: broad jump (12th percentile). College production: 310 receiving yards in 2020, 5th of 10 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 78 career games and 45 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 0.0% (96th percentile), yards per target 9.0 (86th percentile), approximate value 5 (83rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 tight end who played: 486 receiving yards against a median of 193, above the norm.
